description: Client-side script for handling payment processing UI in ERPNext, including payment creation, multi-mode payments, keyboard input, and payment detail display.

classes.name: payments
classes.description: Class managing payment dialog and logic in ERPNext POS interface, extending stock controller.

methods.name: make_payment
methods.description: Initializes and displays the payment dialog, sets up actions and UI.

methods.name: select_text
methods.description: Selects text in form controls when clicked.

methods.name: set_payment_primary_action
methods.description: Defines the primary action (submit) for the payment dialog.

methods.name: make_keyboard
methods.description: Prepares the payment UI with keyboard input and payment template.

methods.name: make_multimode_payment
methods.description: Creates a multi-mode payment entry based on outstanding amount.

methods.name: show_payment_details
methods.description: Displays current payment modes and amounts.

methods.name: set_outstanding_amount
methods.description: Highlights selected payment mode and updates payment value.

methods.name: bind_keyboard_event
methods.description: Binds keyboard input events for payment amount entry.

methods.name: bind_form_control_event
methods.description: Binds click and change events for form controls.

methods.name: highlight_selected_row
methods.description: Highlights the selected payment mode row.

methods.name: bind_numeric_keys_event
methods.description: Binds numeric keypad button clicks for payment input.

methods.name: bind_amount_change_event
methods.description: Binds change event for amount input fields.

methods.name: update_paid_amount
methods.description: Updates the payment data with current input.

methods.name: show_amounts
methods.description: Displays current payment-related amounts in UI.
